entities.name: 十千脚店's riverside hall (two storeys, the upper floor with a railed balcony and diners)
entities.what: Long two-storey hall along the river bank, its front to the south: a big hip-gable (歇山) tiled roof, ridge with an ornament at its east end, a gable triangle with barge boards over the east end; under the eave a band of slanted slats and a beam; the upper storey's front of narrow bays between thin posts: lattice windows (15614-15681, 15861-15955, 15955-16028, 16211-16289), an open panel with a table (15681-15790), a doorway with a standing figure (15800-15855), and an open middle (16028-16197) where diners sit at a table with dishes and a small hanging cloth; in front a balcony with a railing of balusters, which turns at the south-east corner into a side gallery running back north-east under its own slatted roof (a figure stands in it). Under the balcony, east part only (15955-16300): a plain platform band and a tiled pent roof (腰檐) with drip tiles, i.e. the lower storey's eave. The lower storey's walls are not painted (bare trees and plain silk below the pent eave). No writing on it. At the back of the middle bay an open rack of shelves (u 16122-16160, v 1295-1337) stands beside the hanging cloth, a pot on it (S3.prop.pot_on_rack_16140); in the west doorway a plain partition panel (u 15837-15860, v 1320-1390) stands east of the doorway figure.
entities.vis: part: lower storey hidden (trees, plain silk, the silk's bottom edge); west end behind S4b's willow and S4b's south roof; north side behind its own roof
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄 (setting); sections.md:109 (刘涤宇: 十千脚店 two-storey)
entities.note: TWO STOREYS (tested, med conf): under the balcony railing there is no ground, step or column foot; directly below it are a beam (v 1508-1512), a plain platform band (1512-1548) and a tiled roof slope (top 1550-1556, tile ends 1645-1655, eave 1665-1670 with drip tiles), spanning only u 15955-16300 like the band. A roof under the floor = the floor is an upper floor (平坐 over a 腰檐). The alternative, a separate low building in front whose ridge happens to meet the band exactly and share its ends, is less likely. UPPER FLOOR: floor line (the balcony's bottom rail and floor beam) at v 1467-1487 over u 15750-16330, about 1455-1460 at 15600-15750 (behind branches); railing top rail v 1425-1430, window sills v ~1400; straight above the ground at v ~1770 est (hidden; a floor ~3.8 m up, (1770-1475)/77; the pent eave at 1668 fits a lower eave ~1.5 m below the floor projecting ~1.5 m). The side gallery's floor runs from (16330,1500) back to ~(16520,1350), its top rail from (16310,1440) to (16500,1280). TAVERN: read as 十千脚店's 楼 (upper floor of the tavern with drinkers at its windows): it is two-storey (刘涤宇 counts the tavern two-storey; no other two-storey building stands near the gate), its east gallery abuts S3.bld.tavern_wing_16300, and nothing painted (wall, lane, gap) separates it from the tavern's wing and gate. Conf med-low: a separate restaurant beside the tavern cannot be excluded. Roof: ridge (top edge) v 953-969 from its west end (15644, cut by S4b's willow crown) to the east ornament (16408,931); west hip (15644,960)->(15537,1200); front eave double line v 1222-1237; slat band under it v 1235-1290; beam v 1285-1300; east gable triangle 16340-16440 (v 935-1150), east hip (16408,935)->(16320,1262), east barge down-right to (16500,1137) over the gallery roof (16315-16520, v 1150-1250). SW corner post (15513-15540, v 1240-1470). Upper posts (bays above): 15592, 15607-15614, 15681, 15725, 15789-15800, 15861, 15908, 15955, 16028, 16097-16122, 16197-16211, 16289-16303; the bays list puts them on the est ground line. FOOTPRINT is a placeholder: front at the est ground under the balcony (v 1775), depth est 6 m (307 px of v), back corners shifted +294 px of u (dx 49, this area's measured receding slope ~-1.05: see the report's table). Its north side faces the river bank; the route is read along that bank behind it (S3.road.main). SCALE CUES (px): bays ~65-80 wide; lattice windows ~70 wide x 95 tall; seated diners ~100 px from head to seat (painted ~1.4x the frame's 77 px/m); railing 50 px (1427->1477); pent roof 112 px tall on screen. DEPTH DIRECTION: east gallery top rail (16310,1440)->(16500,1280) slope -0.84 and floor edge (16330,1500)->(16520,1350) -0.79 (upper floor, ~4 m up: flattened). Second pass: (1) the rack and the partition were left to this entity by t1 (fixed to the hall) and were in no `what`. (2) t1's 'small object on the gallery railing at about (16358, 1400)' is the railing's corner post cap where the balcony's front railing turns into the side gallery's, a small looped knob at u 16318-16334, v 1398-1412: part of this building; nothing loose stands on the railing (crops c_gallery.jpg, c_railobj.jpg). (3) The east part of the side gallery (u 16400-16540, v 1260-1440) shows only railings and balusters, no further figure (insp_gallery_e.jpg).

entities.name: 十千脚店's wing with the long receding roof (west of the gate)

No wall, door or column of it is painted: under the east eave there is bare ground with the 杈子 barrier. No writing.

entities.name: 十千脚店's gate (门楼 under the 彩楼欢门)
entities.what: The tavern's gate building, front to the south: a tiled roof whose eave has a red-painted fascia, its west hip running down to a front corner, a straight front eave, and its east eave running back north-east; on the roof stands the 彩楼欢门 scaffold. Under the front eave a band of fine vertical hatching (a valance/fringe); at the west front corner a short hanging post (垂柱) ending in a carved knob in mid-air; posts down to the ground at the middle and east; a long striped curtain hangs gathered at the east front post; narrow vertical boards with characters (illegible: □□□□ on the board at 17145-17170, □□ on the board at 17277-17307, two marks like □□ at 17010-17035 above the lamp-box); a fence of vertical bars closes the front (S3.str.gate_fence_16955) with the 十千脚店 lamp-box at its west part.
entities.vis: part: posts' feet below the silk's edge and behind the fence; east side behind the rider (t3) and the curtain
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄; sections.md §2 (彩楼欢门 ≈ 16800-17340)
entities.note: Roof: west hip red fascia (16800,1230)->(16870,1370); tiled front slope v 1320-1375 under the scaffold's lattice base; front eave line v 1372-1378 from 16870 to 17150; east eave (red beam) (17150,1372)->(17330,1185); valance hatching v 1385-1450 over 16893-17153. Hanging post 16910-16925 from the eave to a knob at v 1520-1545 (it does not reach the ground: bare ground below it). Posts to the ground: 17072-17078 (v 1440-1690 seen), 17100-17112, 17136-17164 (heavy, v 1440-1790); posts 17270-17310 (v 1350-1450 seen) under the east eave. Boards: 17145-17170 v 1470-1590; 17277-17307 v 1350-1433; marks at 17010-17035 v 1450-1495. Curtain: striped cloth 17180-17260, v 1380-1650, gathered and tied. The scholarship names boards 天之/美禄 at this gate (余辉's 欢楼美禄); the strokes are not legible at zoom 3, so □ is recorded. FOOTPRINT est: front at the silk's edge (posts run past v 1790), depth from the east eave: (17150,1372)->(17330,1185) is 187 px of v = ~3.6 m at dx ~49. The front eave is ~5.6 m above the est ground (423 px). SCALE CUES (px): hanging post 15 wide; the rider (t3) ~240 tall; the front opening 16925-17150. DEPTH DIRECTION: east eave (17150,1372)->(17330,1185) slope -1.04 (high). Merge: t2 and t3 read the hanging post at the west front as a column standing on a drum-shaped stone base, foot (16916, 1543), carrying the porch eave at v ~1446; this entity reads a 垂柱 ending in a knob in mid-air above bare ground. Same strokes, two readings. t3 also names a slatted lattice panel with a curved top between the curtain and the east post (u 17257-17325, v 1430-1600), part of this gate (a t3 prop only if it stands on its own), and its east-post figure S3.fig.gate_post_figure_17332 stands half behind it. Second pass: (1) between the 杈子's north end and the lamp-box, u 16965-17000, v 1595-1690, a narrow upright panel with curved and scrolled strokes (t2's 'curved strokes at 16977-16997, v 1610-1667'): a carved door leaf or screen at the gate's west side; the tile restyle paints a carved panel here. Part of this building, not a figure (crops c_doorleaf.jpg, insp_doorleaf.jpg, c_gatefront.jpg). (2) The west-front post: its lower end (u 16905-16930, v 1515-1545) is a ringed bulb about as wide as the ringed collar at its top (v 1440-1475), with plain ground under it; it reads more like the carved knob of a hanging post than a drum base, and the tile restyle paints a hanging post ending in mid-air. This weighs toward this entity's 垂柱 reading; t2's and t3's column-on-a-base reading stays possible (crops c_pendant.jpg, insp_pendant.jpg). (3) If S3.fig.behind_lampbox_17090 is declined as a gathered cloth, that cloth (u 17072-17100, v 1580-1650) belongs in this `what`.

entities.name: 十千脚店's 彩楼欢门 (the festive pole scaffold over the gate)
entities.what: A towering openwork scaffold of lashed poles standing on the roof of 十千脚店's gate (S3.bld.tavern_gate_16870): a diamond-lattice band at its base, four horizontal tiers of cross-bars above it, and from them about eighteen poles rising: plain tall poles, three tapering spires of bound poles with many cross-ties, A-frames, and fans of poles splaying outward to the west and east like a crown. No flowers, streamers or lamp-boxes are hung on it (only lashings). The long bar from which the 新酒 banner hangs (t4's S3.prop.xinjiu_flagpole_17630) runs east from the scaffold's east side at v ~905: its west end is tied into the scaffold.
entities.vis: part: the poles' feet hidden behind the lattice band and the gate roof; the back poles behind the front ones
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄; sections.md §2 (彩楼欢门 ≈ 16800-17340)
entities.note: SET PIECE. Stands on the gate roof, not on the ground: base corners are the gate's footprint (est); the custom pole points are where each pole's foot disappears (on the roof or into a tier) and its top. Heights above the est ground at the front (v 1795): lattice base v 1255-1320 (6.2-7.0 m), tiers at v 984-990 (1880-17274), 1040-1046 (16851-17315, the widest: the fans spring from its ends), 1072-1078 and 1116-1125 (16880-17315); the tallest top v 499 = 16.8 m on the front plane (the back poles stand further north, so less). POLES, west to east: pole1: top (16877,652), foot (16893,1255) - tall single pole at the west, slightly leaning west; foot est at the lattice base; pole2: top (16820,870), foot (16895,1040) - splays out west from the west end of tier 2; pole3: top (16808,943), foot (16870,1045) - splays out west, lower, from tier 2; pole4: top (16923,809), foot (16925,984) - A-frame of two legs (16910 and 16940 at tier 1) with a cross-tie at v 920; pole5: top (16942,759) - leaning west from the west spire; pole6: top (16945,856) - short leaning pole beside pole5; pole7: top (16976,659), foot (17000,956) - west spire: a tapering bundle of poles with many cross-ties, base 16958-17045 at v ~956; pole8: top (17015,532), foot (17035,1255) - second-tallest plain pole, rising out of the west spire; pole9: top (17055,711) - A-frame leaning east beside the west spire, a knob at its top; pole10: top (17087,622), foot (17110,980) - tall plain pole in the middle; pole11: top (17120,610) - middle spire with paired cross-ties; pole12: top (17166,606) - east spire with cross-ties; pole13: top (17200,697) - A-frame east of the east spire; pole14: top (17221,722) - short spire; pole15: top (17230,499), foot (17252,860) - the tallest pole, plain, with a wrapped joint at v 805-850; continues down behind the tiers; pole16: top (17280,795) - splays out east; pole17: top (17310,742), foot (17250,930) - splays out east from the east end of the tiers; pole18: top (17334,796) - splays out east, lowest of the east fan. Spires carry ties every ~25-35 px. The lattice band (16880-17113, v 1255-1320) is a parapet of diamond lattice panels; the east part of the base follows the gate's east eave up to ~(17330,1185). The 新酒 bar: v 900-912 from inside the scaffold (u ~17240-17300) east to its tip at u ~17585, just short of the pole at 17615; a stay runs from (17500,880) up to the pole. Pole tops +-5 px, feet est. SCALE CUES (px): poles 6-10 wide; spire bases ~90 wide; tier spacing 30-55 px.

entities.name: main road: the south bank's riverside road, over the Rainbow Bridge, along the north bank
entities.what: The route through S3: from the seam with S4b it runs east along the south bank between the river and the backs of 十千脚店's buildings (hidden behind their roofs and the gate's scaffold), comes into view under the 新酒 banner, crosses the open ground between the tavern and the bridge (the 串车, the shed's stall, porters), climbs the bridge's south ramp through the crowd, crosses the crown and comes down onto the north bank's thin strip, running east along the shop fronts to u 20500. No edge, kerb or paving is drawn; bare earth.
entities.vis: part: hidden behind roofs and the scaffold west of u 17300; the deck stretch is a placeholder
entities.note: WEST OF THE TAVERN DOOR (u 15500-17300) NOTHING OF THE ROAD IS PAINTED: every point there is est. TWO READINGS. (c, used) Riverside road behind the tavern: S4b's visible open ground at the seam (u 15000-15450, v 1050-1250: willow trunks, the strip in front of the tea house with a figure at (14950,1240)) continues east at v ~1215-1240 between the bank (water edge behind the hall's roof, ~v 950-1050) and the backs of the riverside hall, the wing, the rear hall and the gate (all hidden), and comes into view on the open ground under the 新酒 banner (u 17300-17600, v 1100-1350). It stays on the silk, inside the painted area, with no jog at the seam. (b) Street in front of the tavern: the gate, its lamp-box, the bar fence, the 杈子 and the rider all face south toward the silk's bottom edge, so a street runs past the tavern's front there; west of the gate it would lie below the silk's edge (v ~1850-1950, outside the painted area) and would need a hidden ~12 m southward turn at the seam. (b)'s visible part is recorded as the side street S3.road.tavern_front_16620. The lead decides; the builder should not lay a road surface through the hidden stretch without that decision. SEAM S4b (u 15500): centre point 0 = my reading (15500,1240) est, edge_n (15500,1060), edge_s (15500,1300) (the ridge of S4b's south roof at 15330-15500, v 1220-1260); the merge sets point 0 to S4b's point exactly. OPEN GROUND (17300-18450): centre between the shed's customers (v <= 1300) and the 串车 (v >= 1370), then north-east through the crowd at the bridge's foot; edge_s jumps to the silk's edge at 17450 because the forecourt and the open ground in front of the tavern are one plaza with the road. DECK STRETCH (u 18450-20010) IS A PLACEHOLDER from a low-zoom look: the route leaves the ground at about (18450,870) est and lands on the north bank at about (20010,315) est; the merge replaces points 11-16 (18700..20010) and the matching edge points with the bridge agent's deck centre line and edges (S3.str.rainbow_bridge). NORTH BANK: centre on the strip between the shop/tavern fronts (v ~215-250, structures_e's) and the bank's edge over the boat moored along it (v ~290-335); the strip is only ~80-120 px of v (1.6-2.3 m at 51.25 px/m): a real-size problem for the frame. LAST POINT exactly (20500,258) est = S2's datum: the willow (S2's) stands at u ~20505-20583 with its trunk base at v ~280, so the route passes just north-west of its foot. MERGE (2026-10-12): (1) point 0 of the centre and both edges is S4b's road at u 15500 (map/strokes/S4b.json, S4b.road.main), read again on every run of merge_fixes.mjs: centre (15500, 1530, est), edge_n (15500, 1470, est), edge_s (15500, 1605, est) against this agent's reading (15500, 1240), (15500, 1060), (15500, 1300): S4b's route reaches the seam along the front of its house behind the willow (S4b.bld.house_behind_willow_15414), 290 px of v (about 5.7 m of depth) south of the riverside ground this road takes behind the hall, so the hidden stretch now turns north round the hall's north-west corner (all est) between u 15500 and 15840: for the lead and the frame step. (2) The deck stretch is the bridge agent's lines: centre = S3.str.rainbow_bridge deck_c from (18435, 1090) to (19650, 396), edge_n = deck_w (18060-19275), edge_s = deck_e (18810-20025); the placeholder points (18200..20030) are gone. support_ranges puts u 18435-19650 on "bridge deck": that is the centre's whole deck stretch, but the edges' deck points outside it (deck_w at u 18060-18435, deck_e at u 19650-20025) still take the road's own support (ground), and the ground points near the bridge (none of the centre's; edge_s (18420, 1480) and (18600, 1100) south of the foot line) must stay on the ground: the frame agent or the lead settles it (per-line ranges, or the H_profile_X's flat ends). (3) North bank, after the bridge agent and the lead: from the deck's north foot the centre climbs north past the cart's south side to (19900, 262) and runs east at v 262-265 through the tavern's open front (its tables at v 205-280, its front and the water's edge at v ~288-300) to S2's datum, exactly (20500, 258) est; edge_s follows the bank's edge at the tavern's front (v 288, the old 315-335 lay on the water), edge_n runs north of the cart (19750, 160) into the tavern (as before). Along the tavern the edges are 53-65 px of v apart (1.0-1.3 m at 51.25 px/m; the land strip to the shop fronts is 1.6-2.3 m): the lead's note keeps the one-scale frame and settles room to walk at build time. FRAME: each line on its own deck profile (support_by: centre = deck_c on `bridge deck: 375 px west of the near edge`, edge_n = deck_w on `bridge deck: 750 px west of the near edge`, edge_s = deck_e on `bridge deck`), replacing the merge's support_ranges (which applied one support to all three lines by u): each profile is 0 beyond the deck's feet, so the ground points before and after the bridge stay at H 0 and every deck point gets the painted height (the merge's tool-limit note, settled).

entities.name: 十千脚店 (the tavern complex)
entities.what: The tavern: its riverside two-storey hall with drinkers upstairs, the wing and the rear hall behind the gate, the gate with the 彩楼欢门 scaffold on its roof, the bar fence and the 十千脚店 lamp-box at its front, and the 杈子 barrier on the forecourt's west side.
entities.src: 余辉: 欢楼美禄; sections.md §2
entities.note: The riverside hall's membership is a reading (med-low); the rest belong together by the gate. The 新酒 pole and banner (t4), the rider at the gate (t3) and the big parasol east of the gate (t3) are tiles' entities.
